title: Stardust Power Inc. Form 8-K Current Report
summary: Stardust Power Inc. (SDST), a small-cap lithium company listed on Nasdaq Capital Market, filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 disclosing a non-binding Letter of Intent for potential supply of up to 15,000 metric tons per annum of lithium carbonate equivalent. The LOI is subject to due diligence and definitive agreement execution, with no certainty stated.
key_points: Stardust Power Inc. is a Nasdaq Capital Market listed company (ticker SDST) with common stock and redeemable warrants trading.
The company entered a non-binding LOI for up to 15,000 metric tons per annum of lithium carbonate equivalent as lithium chloride.
LOI is subject to further due diligence and definitive agreement execution—outcome is uncertain.
Filed under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) and Item 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits).
Filed by CEO Roshan Pujari on April 13, 2026.
Company qualifies as an emerging growth company under SEC rules.
why_it_matters: This filing is not material to broad financial markets. It represents a routine corporate disclosure from a small-cap company regarding a preliminary, non-binding supply arrangement. The LOI has no certainty of closing and does not constitute market-moving news for equities, commodities, or macro traders.
important_numbers: 15,000 metric tons per annum (lithium carbonate equivalent)
